1.w: And YHWH said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh; for by a mighty hand he will send them out, and by a mighty hand he will drive them out from his land.”

2.w: And God spoke to Moses, and He said to him, “I [am] YHWH,

3.w: and I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as El-Shaddai; and [by] My name YHWH I was not known to them.

4.w: And also I have established My covenant with them, to give to them the land of Canaan, the land of their sojourning, in which they sojourned.

5.w: And also I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel whom Egypt is making serve, and I have remembered My covenant.

6.w: Therefore say to the sons of Israel, ‘I [am] YHWH, and I will bring you⁺ out from under the burdens of Egypt, and I will deliver you⁺ from their service, and I will redeem you⁺ with an outstretched arm and with great judgments.

7.w: And I will take you⁺ to Me for a people, and I will be to you⁺ for God; and you⁺ shall know that I [am] YHWH your⁺ God, the One bringing you⁺ out from under the burdens of Egypt.

8.w: And I will bring you⁺ into the land that I lifted up my hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. And I will give it to you⁺ as a possession. I [am] YHWH!’”

9.w: And Moses spoke in this way to the sons of Israel, and they did not listen to Moses, from shortness of spirit and from hard service.

10.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

11.w: “Go in, tell to Pharaoh king of Egypt and he shall send out the sons of Israel from his land.”

12.w: And Moses spoke before the face of YHWH, saying, “Behold, the sons of Israel have not listened to me; and how shall Pharaoh listen to me, and I [am] uncircumcised of lips?”

13.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron and He gave them a command toward the sons of Israel and toward Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt.

14.w: These [are] the heads of the houses of their fathers: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These are the clans of Reuben.

15.w: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul son of the Canaanitess. These [are] the clans of Simeon.

16.w: And these [are] the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi [were] seven and thirty and a hundred years.

17.w: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their clans.

18.w: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath [were] three and thirty and a hundred years.

19.w: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These [were] the clans of Levi according to their generations.

20.w: And Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister for himself for a wife, and she bore to him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram [were] seven and thirty and a hundred years.

21.w: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

22.w: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Sithri.

23.w: And Aaron took Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, to himself for a wife. And she bore to him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

24.w: And the sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These are the clans of the Korahite.

25.w: And Eleazar son of Aaron took for himself one of the daughters of Putiel to him for a wife, and she bore to him Phinehas. These [are] the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their clans.

26.w: [It was] this Aaron and Moses to whom YHWH said, “Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, according to their hosts.”

27.w: They [are] the ones speaking to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt, this Moses and Aaron.

28.w: And it came to pass on the day [that] YHWH spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

29.w: that YHWH spoke to Moses, saying, “I [am] YHWH; speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I am speaking to you.”

30.w: And Moses said before the face of YHWH, “Behold, I [am] uncircumcised of lips, and how will Pharaoh listen to me?”
